sources.title: [PATCH v2 0/2] media: i2c: Add onsemi AR0234 camera sensor driver

claims.claim: This series adds a driver for the onsemi AR0234 CMOS image sensor. The AR0234 is a 1/2.6-inch global-shutter sensor with a 1940x1220 pixel array, capable of 1920x1200 resolution at up to 120 fps. It supports MIPI CSI-2 output with 1 to 4 data lanes, raw Bayer (8/10-bit) and monochrome formats, as well as DPCM 10->8 compression. sources.title: [PATCH v3 0/2] media: i2c: Add Samsung S5KJN5 image sensor

claims.claim: This series adds support for the Samsung S5KJN5, a 50 MP 10-bit RAW MIPI CSI-2 image sensor. This is implemented as a separate driver rather than extending the existing s5kjn1 driver. Although both sensors belong to the same family, they are different parts with different register maps and power supplies. Combining support for both devices in a single driver would result in very little shared code while introducing separate initialization and control paths, so keeping them as independent drivers

sources.title: [PATCH v7 0/5] Add CAMSS and IMX577 sensor support for Shikra EVK

claims.claim: Shikra EVK is based on the Qualcomm Shikra SoC. It lacks a camera sensor in its default configuration. This series adds CAMSS driver support, CCI definitions and enables the 22-pin IMX577 sensor via CSIPHY1 through device tree overlays. We have tested IMX577 Sensor on CCI1 with following commands: - media-ctl --reset - media-ctl -d /dev/media0 -V '"imx577 1-001a":0[fmt:SRGGB10/4056x3040 field:none]' - media-ctl -d /dev/media0 -V '"msm_csiphy1":0[fmt:SRGGB10/4056x3040]' - media-ctl -d /dev/media0
